metadata.description: Curated Tompkins County attractions. Records merged from prior research and STAMP_Deliverable1_Attractions.pptx.pdf (all source links in that deliverable checked 2026-11-16).

tcat_access_values.year_round: Confirmed year-round TCAT access documented in research
tcat_access_values.summer_only: Seasonal TCAT service only (typically Memorial Day to Labor Day)
tcat_access_values.not_pinned_walkable: On campus or walkable; no specific bus stop pinned in research
tcat_access_values.none_confirmed: No confirmed transit route in research

attractions.name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
attractions.description: Gardens, arboretum, and gorge walks on the Cornell campus
attractions.address: Nevin Welcome Center, Cornell campus, Ithaca, NY
attractions.coordinates_source: nominatim_geocoded (F.R. Newman Arboretum); verify exact point
attractions.hours: Grounds dawn to dusk, every day, year-round; Welcome Center Tue-Sat 11-4

admission.notes: Free; guided tours $12 (free for Cornell students)

tcat_access.notes: Walkable from central campus; bus stop not pinned

attractions.transportation_limitations: Welcome Center lot metered on weekdays; arboretum lots free

attractions.name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
attractions.description: Art museum in an I. M. Pei building on the Arts Quad with lake views and diverse collections
attractions.address: 114 Central Ave, Arts Quad, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Tue-Sun 10-5; special hours during Cornell breaks

tcat_access.notes: Central campus; bus stop not pinned

attractions.transportation_limitations: After-hours parking in Forest Home garage, about a 10-minute walk
attractions.seasonality_notes: Hours can shift during university breaks

attractions.name: McGraw Tower & Cornell Chimes
attractions.description: Campus tradition with live chimes concerts and views from the tower
attractions.address: Central campus, Cornell University, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Tower open during scheduled concerts; three concerts per weekday in the academic year

tcat_access.notes: Central campus, reached on foot

attractions.walking_access: Reached on foot on central campus
attractions.accessibility_notes: 161 steps to the top; no elevator documented
attractions.seasonality_notes: Concert schedule shifts during Cornell breaks

attractions.name: Cornell Lab of Ornithology
attractions.description: Birding, science exhibits, and 5+ miles of trails at Sapsucker Woods
attractions.address: 159 Sapsucker Woods Rd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Visitor Center Tue-Sun 10-4; closed Mon, Thanksgiving, and Christmas to New Year; trails dawn to dusk

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Route 31 documented

attractions.name: Cornell Dairy Bar
attractions.description: Cornell-made ice cream, cafe, and dairy plant viewing in Stocking Hall
attractions.address: Stocking Hall, 411 Tower Rd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Hours change by season

tcat_access.notes: East end of Tower Rd, central campus; bus stop not pinned

attractions.seasonality_notes: Hours change by season; can shift during university breaks

attractions.name: Cascadilla Gorge Trail
attractions.description: Waterfalls, stone stairs, and a gorge hike connecting downtown and the Cornell campus
attractions.address: Linn St (downtown) to College Ave, Ithaca, NY

tcat_access.notes: Walking route between downtown and Collegetown

attractions.walking_access: Walking route between downtown and Collegetown; about 7,800 ft long with a 400 ft climb
attractions.accessibility_notes: Stone stairs and a 400 ft climb; not accessible
attractions.seasonality_notes: Closed for winter from late November; usually reopens around May

attractions.name: Ithaca Commons
attractions.description: Pedestrian mall with shopping, dining, public art, and festivals in the heart of downtown
attractions.address: Downtown Ithaca pedestrian mall, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Year-round; shop hours vary

tcat_access.notes: Main TCAT hub

attractions.name: The History Center in Tompkins County
attractions.description: Local and Indigenous history exhibits and oral histories, on the Commons
attractions.address: 110 N Tioga St, on the Commons, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Exhibit Hall Wed-Sat 10-6; closed Sun-Tue and on Election Days

tcat_access.notes: On the Commons, so any Commons route works

attractions.name: Ithaca Farmers Market
attractions.description: Local produce, crafts, and prepared food at Steamboat Landing on the waterfront
attractions.address: 545 Third St, Steamboat Landing, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Sat 9-3 (Apr-Oct), 10-2 (Nov-Dec); Sun 10-3 (May-Oct), 10-2 (Nov); Jan-Mar: Saturdays indoors at Triphammer Marketplace

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Route 13 documented

attractions.walking_access: On the Cayuga Waterfront Trail for walking or biking
attractions.seasonality_notes: Locations and schedules vary by season; Jan-Mar moves indoors to Triphammer Marketplace, Saturdays only

attractions.name: Sciencenter
attractions.description: Hands-on science museum oriented toward families
attractions.address: 601 1st St, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Tue-Sun 10-5

admission.notes: $12.50; under 2 free; $3 with an EBT card

tcat_access.notes: No confirmed transit route in research

attractions.transportation_limitations: No confirmed transit route; free on-site parking

attractions.name: Museum of the Earth
attractions.description: Fossils and Earth history exhibits oriented toward families
attractions.address: 1259 Trumansburg Rd (Rt 96), Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Thu-Mon 10-5; closed Tue-Wed and around Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Route 21 from an older listing - requires confirmation

attractions.transportation_limitations: Route 21 citation is from an older listing; confirm current service
attractions.seasonality_notes: Closed around Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year

attractions.name: Cayuga Nature Center
attractions.description: Six-story treehouse, live animals, and 5+ miles of trails
attractions.address: 1420 Taughannock Blvd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Trails and TreeTops treehouse daily 10-5; lodge closed for the season

tcat_access.notes: TCAT summer Route 22 only

attractions.transportation_limitations: Only summer TCAT service documented; off-season requires other transport
attractions.seasonality_notes: Lodge closed for the season per research; summer-only TCAT

attractions.name: Taughannock Falls State Park
attractions.description: 215-ft waterfall, gorge trail, and a lake beach; among the tallest falls east of the Rockies
attractions.address: 1740 Taughannock Blvd, Trumansburg, NY
attractions.hours: Dawn to dusk, year-round

admission.notes: Seasonal vehicle fee, good at all state parks that day

tcat_access.notes: TCAT summer Route 22 (weekdays) and Route 23 (weekends)

attractions.walking_access: North end of the Black Diamond Trail
attractions.biking_access: North end of the Black Diamond Trail
attractions.transportation_limitations: Only summer TCAT service documented; car or Black Diamond Trail otherwise
attractions.seasonality_notes: Beach can close for algal blooms; summer-only TCAT routes

attractions.name: Buttermilk Falls State Park
attractions.description: Cascades, swimming hole, and gorge and rim trails
attractions.address: 106 E Buttermilk Falls Rd, off Rt 13 S, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Park dawn to dusk, year-round; Gorge Trail closes early to mid-Nov, reopens early May
attractions.visit_duration: 1 hr gorge; 2-3 hr gorge plus rim

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Route 67 (Lower Buttermilk stop)

attractions.seasonality_notes: Gorge Trail closes early to mid-November and reopens around early May; summer swimming in lifeguarded areas on select days

attractions.name: Robert H. Treman State Park
attractions.description: Enfield Glen, Lucifer Falls, and nine miles of trails
attractions.address: 105 Enfield Falls Rd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Dawn to dusk, year-round

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Route 67 (Lower Treman stop, Elmira Rd at Enfield Creek); summer Route 22

attractions.seasonality_notes: Summer swimming in the lifeguarded area only; vehicle fee Apr to mid-Nov

attractions.name: Ithaca Falls Natural Area
attractions.description: 150-ft waterfall inside the city, with a short steep trail to the base
attractions.address: Lake St and Falls St, Ithaca, NY

tcat_access.notes: Walkable from campus and downtown; no pinned stop

attractions.walking_access: Walkable from campus and downtown; view from the Lake St bridge
attractions.transportation_limitations: Short, steep trail to the base
attractions.accessibility_notes: Short, steep trail to the base; falls can be viewed from the Lake St bridge

attractions.name: Cayuga Waterfront Trail
attractions.description: 8-mile paved, flat, ADA-compliant lakefront path from Stewart Park to Allan H. Treman Marine Park
attractions.address: Stewart Park to Allan H. Treman Marine Park, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Year-round

tcat_access.notes: Reach by TCAT 13 at the Farmers Market or Stewart Park

attractions.seasonality_notes: Most of the Cass Park section is maintained (plowed) in winter

attractions.name: Black Diamond Trail
attractions.area: West shore, Ithaca to Taughannock Falls
attractions.description: 8.4-mile crushed-stone rail-trail from the Children's Garden to Taughannock Falls State Park
attractions.address: Children's Garden to Taughannock Falls State Park, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Year-round; dawn to dusk

admission.notes: Free; park fee if you park in a state park lot

tcat_access.notes: No confirmed transit route in research

attractions.walking_access: Walk or bike; gentle climb northbound
attractions.transportation_limitations: No services along the trail; no confirmed transit route

attractions.name: Stewart Park
attractions.description: Lakefront park with a 1952 carousel, splash pad, and bird sanctuary
attractions.address: South shore of Cayuga Lake, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Park year-round; carousel Memorial Day to Labor Day, Tue-Sun 11-7

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Routes 13 and 36 stop nearby

attractions.seasonality_notes: Carousel runs Memorial Day to Labor Day only

attractions.name: Ithaca Children's Garden
attractions.description: 3-acre garden with the Anarchy Zone play area at the Black Diamond trailhead
attractions.address: 121 Turtle Ln, Cass Park, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Dawn to dusk, 365 days a year

tcat_access.notes: TCAT Cass Park stop, summer only

attractions.biking_access: Black Diamond trailhead; on the Waterfront Trail

attractions.name: Six Mile Creek Vineyard
attractions.description: Ithaca's oldest winery (1987), producing wine and spirits
attractions.address: 1551 Slaterville Rd (Rt 79 E), Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: May-Oct: daily 10-6; Nov-Apr: Sun-Fri 11-6, Sat 10-6; last small-group tastings by 5:30

admission.notes: Tasting price not posted; groups up to 12 by reservation

tcat_access.notes: No confirmed transit route in research; 3.5 mi east of downtown

attractions.transportation_limitations: 3.5 mi east of downtown; no confirmed transit route

attractions.name: South Hill Cider
attractions.description: Orchard cidery with guided tastings, about 4 mi south of the Commons near Buttermilk Falls
attractions.address: 550 Sandbank Rd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Mon 12-7, Thu-Sat 12-9, Sun 12-6; closed Tue-Wed; guided tastings 12-4 Thu-Mon

admission.notes: Classic guided tasting $29; reservations encouraged; 21+; no outside food or alcohol

tcat_access.notes: No confirmed transit route in research

attractions.transportation_limitations: About 4 mi south of the Commons; no confirmed transit route

attractions.name: Ithaca Beer Co. Taproom
attractions.area: West of Ithaca, off Elmira Rd
attractions.description: Brewery and farm-to-table taproom between Buttermilk and Treman state parks
attractions.address: 122 Ithaca Beer Dr, off Elmira Rd, Ithaca, NY
attractions.hours: Wed-Thu 4-9, Fri-Sat 12-9, Sun 12-6

tcat_access.notes: Route 67 runs on Elmira Rd; no confirmed stop documented

attractions.transportation_limitations: Route 67 runs on the Elmira Rd corridor but no confirmed stop is documented; verify before relying on transit

attractions.name: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail
attractions.description: America's first wine trail, running north along Cayuga Lake on Rt 89
attractions.address: North from Ithaca on Rt 89
attractions.hours: Members open year-round; hours vary

tcat_access.notes: Car or tour; no confirmed transit route in research

attractions.transportation_limitations: Car or tour required; most member wineries sit outside Tompkins County

attractions.name: Cornell University
attractions.description: Ivy League campus with historic buildings, gorges, and the Arts Quad

tcat_access.notes: Campus served by TCAT; stop not pinned

attractions.name: Triphammer Falls
attractions.description: Scenic waterfall in Fall Creek gorge, easily accessible from campus

tcat_access.notes: Short walk from campus

attractions.name: Collegetown
attractions.description: Student-oriented district with shops, restaurants, and nightlife

tcat_access.notes: Walkable from Cornell

attractions.name: Moosewood Restaurant
attractions.description: Famous vegetarian restaurant known for its cookbooks and sustainable practices

tcat_access.notes: Downtown location near Commons

attractions.name: Cayuga Lake
attractions.description: Longest of the Finger Lakes with boating, swimming, and scenic views

tcat_access.notes: Multiple access points

attractions.name: Greek Peak Mountain Resort
attractions.description: Ski resort with winter sports and summer activities

tcat_access.notes: Outside Tompkins County

attractions.name: Trumansburg Wineries & Farms
attractions.description: Cluster of wineries, cideries, and farms in the Trumansburg area

tcat_access.notes: Car recommended
